title: Credit Hold is also checked when invoicing a self-billed work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself, on the COD credit term.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, that bills itself.
  • Open work order 1 in two browser tabs.
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab, open the Finance tab.
  2. Switch to the second tab.
  3. Open customer A's Edit Customer window.
  4. Change Credit Terms to Credit Hold.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Switch to the first tab.
  7. Click Create Invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Create Invoice is enabled.

Step 2:

  • The second tab shows work order 1 for customer A.

Step 3:

  • Customer A's Edit Customer window opens.

Step 4:

  • Credit Terms shows Credit Hold.

Step 5:

  • Customer A is saved on Credit Hold.

Step 6:

  • The first tab still shows Create Invoice enabled.

Step 7:

  • Invoicing is refused with the same message as today: "Cannot invoice this customer. Customer is on Credit Hold"
  • No invoice is created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • Feature Overview, Release day: “Credit Hold blocking Create Invoice is now also checked on the server. The same customers are blocked, with the same message (Story 7).”
  • S7-N2: “When the customer pays for itself, Credit Hold reads and blocks exactly as today ("This customer is on Credit Hold!", "Cannot invoice this customer. Customer is on Credit Hold").”
  • Key Decisions: “The Bill To's Credit Hold blocks invoicing, checked on the server; its credit limit warns but never blocks.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
